cards.title: Knights: the front line
cards.text: Six knights, each holding the line a different way.
cards.why: You asked for every pick to be its own unit. This is what makes each one play differently. Mark any that's wrong or dull.
cards.pick: Go with these; each one's move is its unlockable ability in its skill tree.
cards.details: Base attacks stay plain. Each unit's move here is its ability, unlocked in its skill tree, so a level-1 unit just fights with its weapon. Kept to one move each so they're easy to tell apart in a fight.

parts.title: Paladin
parts.text: Sword and shield. Guards a hurt ally: stands next to them and takes part of the damage meant for them.

parts.title: Old Guard
parts.text: Two-handed greatsword. Slow, wide sweeps that hit everything in front.

parts.title: Dame
parts.text: A duellist. Quick sword; blocks a hit now and then and strikes straight back.

parts.title: Bastion, Tower
parts.text: Pure wall. Plants the tower shield: takes far less damage and draws every enemy near.

parts.title: Bastion, Bulwark
parts.text: Spear and round shield. Long reach: fights from just behind the front, keeps enemies at spear length.

parts.title: Bastion, Griffon
parts.text: Warhammer. Leaps onto a far enemy and lands with a shove that knocks those around it back.

cards.title: Rogues: quick and sly
cards.text: Three rogues: one kills, one earns, one hides.
cards.why: You asked for every pick to be its own unit. This is what makes each one play differently. Mark any that's wrong or dull.
cards.pick: Go with these; each one's move is its unlockable ability in its skill tree.
cards.details: Base attacks stay plain. Each unit's move here is its ability, unlocked in its skill tree, so a level-1 unit just fights with its weapon. Kept to one move each so they're easy to tell apart in a fight.

parts.title: Twinfang
parts.text: Twin daggers. A fast flurry on one target; best at finishing the hurt ones.

parts.title: Bandit
parts.text: The money one. Grabs coins from further away, and what it kills drops extra coins.

parts.title: Shade
parts.text: Slips out of sight for a moment; the next hit from behind is a big backstab.

cards.title: Farmers: tools as weapons
cards.text: Four farmers, each tool doing what it does on a farm.

parts.title: Granny Reaper
parts.text: Scythe. A slow sweep all the way round her, hitting everyone close.

parts.title: Haymaker
parts.text: Pitchfork. Shoves enemies back hard; one shoved into a wall takes extra damage.

parts.title: Digger
parts.text: Spade. Digs a trench that slows enemies crossing it.

parts.title: Grandpa Sickle
parts.text: Sickle. Quick cuts that hit much harder on enemies already low.

cards.title: Barbarians: big hits
cards.text: Four barbarians, each strong in a different way.
cards.why: You asked for every pick to be its own unit. This is what makes each one play differently. Mark any that's wrong or dull.
cards.pick: Go with these; each one's move is its unlockable ability in its skill tree.

parts.title: Wildmane
parts.text: Big sword. Gets stronger the more hurt he is.

parts.title: Bearskin
parts.text: Spiked club. Grabs an enemy and throws it into others.

parts.title: Warhelm
parts.text: Hammer. Slams the ground: everyone around is knocked back and staggered.

parts.title: Berserker
parts.text: Flail. Spins it while moving, hitting everything around; can't stop for a few seconds.

cards.title: Undead: one habit each
cards.text: The skeletons and the banshee, each with one simple habit.
cards.why: You said to make enemies for the statuses, not bolt statuses on. These are kept simple, like the rats.
cards.details: Rats stay as they are now. The status ones (lizardman wet, spider tangle, snowman chill, fire slime burn) come with stage 4, when those statuses are in.

parts.title: Rattler
parts.text: The plain skeleton: a sword, walks in, swings.

parts.title: Rattler, bow
parts.text: Shoots from range and backs away.

parts.title: Rattler, spear
parts.text: Reach: stabs from further off.

parts.title: Rattler, mace
parts.text: Slow, heavy hits that stagger.

parts.title: Gaper
parts.text: Two long swords, angry: fast and charges straight in.

parts.title: Brute
parts.text: Shield: blocks hits from the front, so it has to be hit from the side or back.

parts.title: Banshee
parts.text: Floats over hazards; a scream that slows everyone near.

cards.title: Creatures: one habit each
cards.text: The new creatures, each with one habit, built around a status where it has one.
cards.why: You said to make enemies for the statuses, not bolt statuses on. These are kept simple, like the rats.
cards.details: Rats stay as they are now. The status ones (lizardman wet, spider tangle, snowman chill, fire slime burn) come with stage 4, when those statuses are in.

parts.title: Slime
parts.text: As now: splits into small slimes when it dies.

parts.title: Fire slime
parts.text: Burn: leaves a burning patch where it hops.

parts.title: Mimic
parts.text: Looks like a chest until the party comes close; normal drops and XP when killed.

parts.title: Bat
parts.text: Flies over hazards; darts in, bites, darts out.

parts.title: Ghost
parts.text: Drifts through walls; fades in and out.

parts.title: Lizardman
parts.text: Wet: a spear lunge that soaks what it hits.

parts.title: Spider
parts.text: Webs: shoots a strand that tangles a hero in place for a moment.

parts.title: Snowman
parts.text: Chill: throws snowballs that slow.
